The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Role: 

We are looking for an entrepreneurial, driven and accomplished new business sales professional to join our growing Singapore team, focused on selling to the Financial Services market (Buy & Sell side Investment) in France & Southern Europe. This is an opportunity to join a high growth company, sell an award winning product that is rapidly getting adopted across the market internationally, and this person will be able to make a significant contribution in the company’s growth and future success.

What You’ll Do: 

  • Take responsibility for the end-end sales processes in your territory, targeting hedge funds, asset managers, investment bankers and sell side research departments.
  • This is a new client acquisition sales role, requiring you to research opportunities, initiate discussions, build prospect relationships, conduct demos, manage product trials and close sales with prospects in Europe and France
  • Forecast accurately and develop necessary pipeline to meet and exceed goals
  • Work closely with our Product Specialist team during trials to ensure client engagement
  • Gather and pass on information on market and client product needs to sales, product management, content, and product marketing to help us continually enhance our products

Who You Are:

  • Experience selling a SaaS Technology or platform to Hedge Funds, Asset Management firms and Investment Banks across UK & Southern Europe (France & French speaking territories). 
  • Proven track record of achieving sales targets; we are building a team of top sales performers and a great winning culture, so looking for people who share the same experience and values and together we can continue on our explosive growth
  • Able to prospect and build a pipeline, from identifying the right opportunities to gaining access to the right levels of and across an organization; influencing and building advocacy to create the conditions for enterprise
  • Energetic and creative individual, possessing natural curiosity with the ability to learn quickly
  • Reputation for consistently delivering results and setting the example for work ethic, initiative, enthusiasm, and commitment
  • Fluent/Native French speaking (expert communicator with the ability to comfortably communicate across all levels of an organisation) 
  • Able to travel to clients monthly or quarterly based on business needs

description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role 

The Data Engineering team builds and operates the data platform that powers analytics, business intelligence, operational reporting, and data-driven products across Nebius. We ingest data from internal and external systems, develop reliable transformation pipelines and data models, and make trusted datasets available to business and product teams.

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to own substantial parts of our data platform and deliver complex data products end to end. You will turn ambiguous business needs into pragmatic technical solutions, make architecture and implementation trade-offs, and improve the reliability, scalability, and usability of our data ecosystem.

You will work closely with product, platform, and business teams, helping them use data effectively while ensuring that our systems remain maintainable and trustworthy as Nebius grows.

Your responsibilities: 

  • Own the design, delivery, and operation of complex data pipelines, datasets, and platform components.
  • Translate business and analytical requirements into scalable data models, reliable data products, and clear technical plans.
  • Design and evolve data architecture, storage, processing, and orchestration patterns for large-scale workloads.
  • Improve data quality, observability, lineage, and incident response for critical datasets and pipelines.
  • Investigate and resolve challenging performance, reliability, and data-correctness issues in production.
  • Establish reusable tools, conventions, and automation that improve engineering productivity and reduce operational risk.
  • Work with product teams and business stakeholders to define data contracts, priorities, and success criteria.
  • Contribute to technical direction through design reviews, thoughtful trade-offs, and documentation.
  • Support and mentor other engineers through reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation and take ownership of improving the operational health of the systems you support.

Must-haves: 

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering, backend engineering, or a related role; or equivalent experience delivering and operating production data systems.
  • Proven experience independently delivering complex data pipelines or data-platform capabilities from problem definition through production operation.
  • Strong Python and SQL skills, including writing maintainable production code and optimizing non-trivial queries.
  • Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, including designing maintainable analytical models and data contracts for multiple consumers.
  • Solid knowledge of data architectures and storage systems, including the trade-offs between different processing and storage approaches.
  • Experience designing for reliability: testing, monitoring, data-quality validation, alerting, debugging, and incident resolution.
  • Ability to make technical decisions under ambiguity, explain trade-offs clearly, and collaborate effectively with engineers and non-technical stakeholder

Nice-to-haves: 

  • Experience with real-time or event-driven data platforms and streaming technologies.
  • Experience building or operating cloud-native services with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code, particularly Terraform.
  • Experience with data governance, access control, privacy, and compliance requirements such as GDPR or SOC 2.
  • Experience with data observability and quality tools or frameworks, such as Great Expectations.
  • Experience improving engineering standards through shared libraries, platform tooling, technical documentation, or mentoring.

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI 

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire. 

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

This is a Full-Time Role (40 hours per week, 5 days per week) with no option for part-time work. While this is a remote-first opportunity, the candidate filling this role must be a resident of the Netherlands, the U.K. or Brazil at the start of employment. Additionally, they must be within commuting distance of our office in Amsterdam, London, or São Paulo. 
Please visit our Careers page to review all opportunities and submit your application for the role(s) that best fit your location and work authorization.

About the Role

The Data & AI team is responsible for building B Lab's data platform, delivering on business priorities, and scaling AI adoption across the organization. The team reports directly to the CTDO. The Data & ML Platforms team owns the data platform, ML infrastructure, and the foundational data models the rest of the Data & AI team depends on — the supply-side capability layer that Business & Data Priorities and AI Enablement build on. 

As the Data Governance Lead on the Data & ML Platforms pillar, you own data standards, definitions, and sensitivity classification across B Lab's data platform, and ensure the platform and its analytics comply with relevant laws and documentation requirements. Beyond governance, you play a growing role in building data literacy across the organization — helping teams understand and trust the data available to them, and ensuring definitions and standards are actually adopted, not just documented. You work closely with the Senior Analytics Engineer and Data Engineer to make sure new models and pipelines are built to standard from the start.

Core Responsibilities 

Data Standards & Governance (35%):

  • Own Data Standards & Definitions: Establish and maintain the organization's data standards, definitions, and sensitivity classifications.
  • Ensure Compliance: Keep the data platform and analytics practices compliant with relevant laws and internal policy.

Data Literacy & Adoption (30%):

  • Drive Standards Adoption: Work across pillars to ensure data standards are actually used, not just documented.
  • Build Data Literacy: Develop training, documentation, and other enablement so teams across B Lab can confidently interpret and trust the data available to them.

Cross-Pillar Partnership (25%):

  • Partner with Platform Peers: Work with the Senior Analytics Engineer and Data Engineer to ensure new models and pipelines are built to standard.
  • Support Pillar 2 & 3: Help Network Priorities, Regional Enablement, and AI Enablement apply data standards consistently in their work.

Strategic Innovation & Business Impact (10%):

  • Evaluate Governance Tooling: Explore and pilot new tools or approaches for data cataloging, lineage, and standards enforcement.
  • Quantify Literacy Impact: Track and articulate how improved data literacy and standards adoption reduce rework and improve decision quality across teams. 

Major Objectives/Project for the role in the first 6-12 months
  • Create concepts for data classification (public, private, sensitive, etc)
  • Apply concepts to our data 
  • Enable network to understand concepts and how to interact with them
  • Enable the Data Platform to be more aligned with regulatory requirements and laws 

About You

  • Overall 3+ years of experience in data modeling and/or data governance roles
  • SQL/Data Fluency: Working knowledge of SQL and data models sufficient to audit and advise on governance implementation.
  • Data Governance: Experience establishing and maintaining data standards, definitions, and sensitivity/classification frameworks.
  • Data Literacy & Enablement: Experience communicating technical data concepts to non-technical stakeholders and driving adoption of standards across teams.
  • Compliance Knowledge: Familiarity with data-related legal and regulatory requirements relevant to the organization's data platform and analytics.
  • Documentation: Strong written communication skills; comfort building and maintaining clear, discoverable documentation.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Ability to influence without direct authority across the Data & AI department.
  • Excellent communication skills and comfort with facilitating live and asynchronous trainings or workshops on data governance
  • A BA/BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred
  • Fluent in English

 

Compensation Details

B Lab has a compensation plan that includes:

  • An annual salary in the range of €51,000.00 - €61,000.00 (inclusive of holiday allowance) based on experience and skills
  • 20 vacation days per year, prorated to your start date - front-loaded and restarting each January 1; increased to 25 days after third anniversary 
  • After your first year of employment, 40 hours paid time off for community service; 40 hours of paid time off for professional development with access to a professional development budget (we assess this PD budget annually)
  • Flexibility to use 3 floating holidays and 2 personal days
  • Additional time off during org- wide closures when the entire organization is closed (not including holidays)
  • B Lab pension scheme
  • One-time stipend to make your home-based workspace more comfortable
  • A remote-first workplace
  • A flexible work environment with the ability to plan your work week around your personal commitments

 

This is a Full-Time Role (40 hours per week, 5DWW) with no option for part-time work. 

This job ad is for Amsterdam, NLD. While this is a remote-first opportunity, the candidate filling this role must hold work authorization to work in the Netherlands without any time limitations or any other restrictions, and they must be a resident of the Netherlands at the start of employment. Additionally, they must be within commuting distance of our office in Amsterdam. This role is not eligible to be remote from other countries in Europe. If you wish to be based in one of our other locations listed for this role, please visit our Careers page and submit your application through the job ad that best fits with where you hold residency and work authorization.

  • Resume - Please submit an English translation of your resume
  • Complete responses to our standard set of application questions - Please respond to our questions in English

Please do not include a cover letter. Please note that incomplete applications will not be considered.

About B Lab
B Lab™ is the nonprofit behind Certified B Corporations™, a community of businesses that meet verified social, environmental, and governance standards. Together, our movement is working towards a more inclusive, equitable, and fair economic system.

Our history
B Lab began in 2006 with the idea that a different kind of economy was not only possible — it was necessary. Our founders Andrew Kassoy, Bart Houlahan, and Jay Coen Gilbert believed there was a better way to do business: better for workers, better for communities, and better for the planet. When our movement’s first 81 Founding B Corps signed the Declaration of Interdependence in 2007, they were not just proposing a better way of doing business. What we’ve achieved 
B Lab became known for certifying B Corporations™, companies that meet verified standards of social and environmental performance, accountability, and transparency. But we do much more than that. We help mobilize a global community of businesses committed to collective action on society’s most critical challenges. In 2010, B Lab was part of successfully drafting and passing benefit corporation in Maryland, the first U.S. state to do so. This created a legal framework that allows companies to keep their values of care and community, not just shareholder value, at the forefront. Today, benefit corporation legislation is active in 52 jurisdictions around the world. 

Our future
In 2024, leaders from across the network agreed to evolve into a more integrated organization that embodies interdependence. This next iteration of our global network will balance global coherence with local agency to achieve our vision of economic systems change. We are now building this future together.

As the Data Governance Lead on the Data & ML Platforms pillar, you own data standards, definitions, and sensitivity classification across B Lab's data platform, and ensure the platform and its analytics comply with relevant laws and documentation requirements. Beyond governance, you play a growing role in building data literacy across the organization — helping teams understand and trust the data available to them, and ensuring definitions and standards are actually adopted, not just documented. Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

POSITION OVERVIEW

Product marketing at Mews is at a turning point. The function has been effective at launching products; what it has not yet built is the strategic layer that comes after launch – the continuous positioning, adoption strategy, and market intelligence that makes each product more valuable over time. This role owns that shift.

The Director of Product Marketing and Market Research is a combined senior leadership role responsible for two things that should never have been separated: how Mews brings products to market, and how Mews understands the market it operates in. You will lead the product marketing team, own the research and customer insights function, and serve as the go-to authority on both disciplines for senior leadership across the business.

Mews operates across property management, fintech and payments, guest experience, and marketplace. The right person for this role knows how to build a coherent positioning story across a complex multi-product portfolio – and how to ground that story in real market intelligence, customer insight, and competitive understanding rather than assumption.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Product marketing strategy

  • Define and own product marketing strategy across the Mews portfolio – covering positioning, messaging, and go-to-market execution from launch through adoption and ongoing engagement.

  • Build and govern the global product launch framework so that launches are scalable and repeatable, with clear handoffs between strategy and execution.

  • Own product adoption and post-launch engagement strategy – moving the function beyond launch execution to continuous market thinking that drives usage, retention, and revenue contribution.

  • Partner with Product, Sales, RevOps, and Customer Success to ensure product marketing strategy connects to commercial outcomes and is reflected in how the business goes to market.

  • Own NPS tracking programs and design the measurement framework for product marketing impact, including product attach rates, adoption metrics, and pipeline contribution.

Market research and customer insights

  • Own the end-to-end market research function: identifying research opportunities, designing methodology, running studies, synthesising findings, and activating insights across the business.

  • Lead primary and secondary research initiatives that inform strategic, commercial, and product decisions – including competitive analysis, customer behaviour, market sizing, and buyer intelligence.

  • Build competitive intelligence as a structured, ongoing discipline – not a one-off project. Translate competitive signals into positioning decisions, sales enablement, and product roadmap input.

  • Serve as the functional authority on what the market is telling Mews, and translate that into insight narratives that influence senior leadership decisions and business strategy.

  • Work closely with Strategy, Product, RevOps, and Marketing to ensure insights land where decisions get made, not just where they get read.

Team and function leadership

  • Lead and develop a team of product marketers, setting clear expectations, building capability, and creating a culture of commercial accountability.

  • Set the operating model for how the team works with AI – determining where AI handles execution tasks and where human judgment is irreplaceable, and building team-level standards accordingly.

  • Serve as the senior leadership go-to on product marketing and market intelligence – the person any executive can trust for a well-grounded, commercially-connected answer.

  • Represent product marketing and research in executive forums, contributing to annual planning and portfolio prioritisation decisions.

REQUIREMENTS

Professional knowledge and experience

  • 10+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with the majority of that time in product marketing – not demand generation, not agency, not brand-only roles.

  • Has held a Director, Senior Director, or Head of Product Marketing title, or a broader marketing leadership title that included ownership of the product marketing function.

  • Proven track record managing and developing a multi-person product marketing team, including hiring, coaching, and performance management.

  • Experience owning or significantly contributing to a market research or customer insights function – primary research methodology, competitive intelligence programs, or voice-of-customer work.

  • Deep understanding of B2B SaaS go-to-market strategy: positioning, messaging architecture, pricing and packaging alignment, sales enablement, and lifecycle marketing.

  • Experience building or significantly reshaping a product marketing function – not just managing an inherited one.

  • Has operated in a lean, fast-moving environment such as a scale-up, growth-stage, or pre-IPO company. Experience only in large enterprise environments with unlimited resources is unlikely to be a strong fit.

Skills and capabilities

  • Owns GTM strategy end-to-end – from initial positioning through post-launch adoption and continuous market engagement. Experience limited to launch execution is not sufficient.

  • Connects product marketing directly to revenue outcomes. Can articulate how their work has influenced pipeline, product attach rates, adoption, or retention – not just campaign outputs.

  • Translates research into business decisions – not just insight reports. Has a track record of research that changed a strategic or commercial direction.

  • Multi-functional marketing experience beyond product marketing, for example content, SEO, digital, demand generation, or go-to-market strategy.

  • Metrics-driven. Comfortable defining and owning the measurement framework for both product marketing impact and research quality.

  • Strong senior stakeholder communication. Able to influence executive decisions, present with authority, and earn trust through substance rather than seniority alone.

  • Publicly visible in the product marketing or insights community – speaker, writer, or recognised contributor to the discipline. Not a requirement, but a meaningful differentiator.

AI fluency

AI is changing the product marketing function in a way that is more structural than any other recent technology shift. A significant part of this role is deciding what that means for the team at Mews – what AI handles, what stays human, and how to build a team that operates at a higher strategic level as execution work is automated.

We expect this person to: use AI tools deliberately and with criteria; describe specific examples of AI changing how they or their team works strategically; have a point of view on where the product marketing function is heading as AI matures; and build team-level standards for AI use, including how to review and quality-control AI-assisted outputs before they reach senior stakeholders or customers.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Fintech, payments, or financial services product marketing experience.

  • Hospitality, travel tech, or hotel SaaS background.

  • Both fintech and hospitality in one profile is the strongest possible combination for this role.

  • Global market experience.

  • Experience in a company that has undergone a go-to-market transformation.

Life at Mews

description:
Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Group Overview

Electromagnetic and Cyber Group (EM&C) is responsible for developing flexible and survivable advanced electronic warfare and secure communications equipment while providing the industry’s leading signals intelligence, electronic warfare, and cyber experts. Metrea specialises in signal classification, direction finding, advanced geolocation techniques, and waveform development including waveforms for MANET and LPI/LPD applications. Metrea also develops special purpose radios for government customers and licenses DF and geolocation solutions to multiple OEMs.

The Expeditionary Operations Lab, or EXOLAB, focuses on the rapid development, integration, evaluation and delivery of expeditionary capabilities within the Electromagnetic Warfare and Cyber domain. EXOLAB works across research and development, experimentation, prototyping, systems integration, trials and operational delivery. The team addresses complex customer problems by combining existing technologies, emerging capabilities and internally developed solutions into deployable systems. The lab operates across airborne, land, maritime and dismounted environments, with a strong emphasis on practical engineering, rapid learning and delivering systems that are operationally relevant, supportable and resilient. 

Position Summary

We are seeking a Principal RF Engineer to lead and support the research, design, development, integration and delivery of radio-frequency systems for expeditionary Electronic Warfare, signals intelligence, spectrum operations and secure communications capabilities. 

The role will be responsible for the RF engineering aspects of prototype and operational systems, including RF architecture, receiver and transmitter chains, antenna systems, signal distribution, filtering, amplification, frequency conversion, interference management and system performance analysis. 

The Principal RF Engineer will operate as a senior technical authority within a multidisciplinary team comprising electrical, systems, mechanical, software, cyber and operational specialists. The role will support the full engineering lifecycle, from concept development and technology evaluation through detailed design, integration, verification, trials, deployment and through-life support. 

This is a practical, delivery-focused engineering role. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between theoretical analysis, simulation, laboratory testing, prototype development, platform integration and field trials. 

The role will be based either in Lincoln or London, with a longer-term intent to transition the primary location to London if hired initially in Lincoln. 

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop and integrate RF systems for expeditionary Unmanned Systems control, Electronic Warfare, signals intelligence, spectrum-monitoring and secure communications capabilities.  
  • Develop RF system architectures covering antennas, receivers, transmitters, amplifiers, filters, frequency conversion, switching and signal distribution.  
  • Conduct RF performance analysis, including gain, noise figure, sensitivity, dynamic range, linearity, link budgets and interference assessments.  
  • Support rapid R&D, prototyping and technology evaluation, translating operational requirements into practical and deployable RF solutions.  
  • Integrate commercial, government and internally developed RF equipment across airborne, vehicle-mounted, maritime, fixed-site and unmanned platforms.  
  • Plan and conduct RF testing, characterisation, fault diagnosis, verification and corrective engineering activity.  
  • Ensure RF designs consider electromagnetic compatibility, spectrum management, grounding, bonding, shielding, environmental protection and relevant standards.  
  • Work closely with electrical, mechanical, software, cyber, systems and operational teammates throughout the engineering lifecycle.  
  • Support UK and international trials, demonstrations, installations, commissioning and operational deployments.  
  • Provide RF technical leadership, design assurance and clear engineering recommendations to customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders. 

What You Bring

  • Degree in RF Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering or a closely related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience
  • Minimum of seven years’ experience in RF systems design, development, integration, testing or delivery
  • Experience working with complex RF systems within defence, aerospace, telecommunications, Electronic Warfare, signals intelligence, secure communications or a related sector
  • Experience with Software Defined Radios, digital RF architectures and the collection or analysis of IQ data
  • Experience designing, integrating or supporting RF systems for unmanned systems, including uncrewed aerial, ground or maritime platforms
  • Strong understanding of RF receiver and transmitter architectures, including amplifiers, filters, mixers, oscillators, switches and frequency-conversion stages 
  • Experience conducting cascade analysis, link-budget calculations and assessments of gain, noise figure, sensitivity, linearity and dynamic range
  • Practical experience with antenna systems, RF distribution, transmission lines, impedance matching, grounding, bonding and shielding
  • Strong RF test, measurement and fault-finding skills using equipment such as spectrum analysers, vector network analysers, signal generators, oscilloscopes and power meters
  • Experience using RF simulation, modelling, schematic-capture or system-analysis tools
  • Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams spanning electrical, mechanical, software, cyber, systems and operational disciplines
  • Ability to produce clear technical documentation, communicate engineering recommendations and travel regularly within the UK and internationally

Additional Eligibility Qualifications

  • Experience designing expeditionary, deployable, ruggedised or rapidly reconfigurable RF capabilities
  • Experience integrating RF systems onto airborne, vehicle-mounted, maritime, fixed-site or dismounted platforms
  • Understanding of antenna selection, placement, radiation patterns, platform effects and co-site interference
  • Experience with wideband receivers, transmit chains, power amplifiers, low-noise amplifiers, filters and RF switching networks
  • Experience conducting electromagnetic compatibility, electromagnetic environmental effects and radio-frequency interference assessments
  • Familiarity with relevant defence, aviation, maritime, spectrum-management or RF engineering standards
  • Experience supporting prototype builds, field trials, exercises, customer demonstrations or operational deployments
  • Knowledge of systems engineering, size, weight, power and cooling analysis, low-volume manufacturing, component obsolescence and through-life support

Benefits

  • Private medical insurance  
  • Subsidised gym membership / plans through Wellhub  
  • Electric car scheme  
  • Cycle to work scheme  
  • Salary sacrifice pension scheme  
  • Free lunch on office days  
  • Enhanced parental leave  
  • 30 days annual PTO plus bank holidays  

Work Authorization / Security Clearance

The successful candidate must have the right to work in the United Kingdom. 

The role will require the individual to hold, or be capable of obtaining and maintaining, an appropriate UK national-security clearance. Certain projects may impose additional nationality or security restrictions. 

AAP/EEO Statement

Metrea Mission Data Limited is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or other characteristics protected by law.  

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time position with typical working hours of Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. This position is offered on a hybrid working basis with three days per week in the office as standard, based out of London or Lincoln.

Work Environment

The role will involve work across: 

  • Office and engineering-design environments 
  • Laboratories and workshops
  • Customer and supplier facilities
  • Vehicle, aircraft and maritime-platform integration environments
  • Outdoor test, trial and exercise locations
  • Operationally representative and potentially austere environments  

Appropriate training, procedures and personal protective equipment will be provided where required. 

The role is not exclusively desk-based. It may involve: 

  • Standing, walking, bending, kneeling and working in restricted equipment spaces
  • Handling tools, cables, connectors and test equipment
  • Installing or removing electrical and electronic equipment
  • Lifting and carrying equipment within appropriate manual-handling limits
  • Working around vehicles, aircraft, generators and other powered systems
  • Periods of outdoor work in varying environmental conditions

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with additional needs to perform the essential functions.

Travel

15%

Our Firmware

At Metrea, our single core value is Rooted in Humility, and our four cornerstone attributes are Entrepreneurial, Systematic, Discerning, and Over-Deliver. These form what we call our Teammate Firmware. Just like technical firmware connects software and hardware, our Firmware is the constant interface between our mission and our people. It defines how we show up, how we work together, and how we solve complex problems.

Our team Firmware creates a web-like, hyper-collaborative, dynamically hierarchical way of working that helps us adapt quickly, communicate openly, and distribute decision-making to where expertise actually lives. It enables groups to self-organize around hard problems, shift fluidly as priorities evolve, and operate with the trust, curiosity, and discipline required in a complex mission space. This foundation allows us to deliver elegant, effective solutions and uphold our purpose: protecting our precious inheritance.

We are looking for a Product Manager to support the build, rollout, adoption, and continuous improvement of AI-powered products used across Guidepoint’s expert-network operations.

This role sits at the intersection of product management, product operations, workflow automation, AI adoption, and internal tools. The ideal candidate is a hands-on problem solver who can work closely with users, engineering, QA, design, operations, and leadership to turn high-friction workflows into reliable, scalable product systems.

The Product Manager will support a portfolio of mature and emerging initiatives by writing clear requirements, managing user feedback, looking at adoption, usage data & analytics, triaging issues, supporting UAT and helping teams make data-driven product improvements. This role is especially important as Guidepoint expands its use of AI, automation, and human-in-the-loop workflows across complex operational processes.

What You’ll Do:

Product Delivery & Execution

  • Partner with engineering, QA, UX, and business stakeholders to support timely and high-quality delivery of product improvements.
  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, UAT, release readiness, and post-release review.
  • Help ensure features are tested against real user workflows, edge cases, business rules, and operational expectations.
  • Support rollout planning, user onboarding, training, and adoption follow-ups for new and existing product capabilities.

Product Operations & Workflow Support

  • Act as a day-to-day product contact for users
  • Triage bug reports, user questions, change requests, and product feedback.
  • Translate recurring themes into clear product requirements, tickets, acceptance criteria, and follow-up actions.
  • Maintain strong product hygiene across Jira, Confluence, release notes, user documentation, and training materials.

AI Workflows & Tools

  • Work with product and engineering teams to ensure AI-driven features are usable, measurable, and aligned with real business workflows.
  • Help identify where automation is working well, where users are intervening, and where product improvements are needed.

Metrics, Adoption & Continuous Improvement

  • Track product adoption, usage, user friction, defects, release outcomes, and operational impact.
  • Build and maintain lightweight dashboards, recurring reports, and product health views.
  • Synthesize input from users, support channels, usage data, QA findings, and stakeholder feedback to recommend product improvements.
  • Support quarterly and sprint-level planning by bringing structured insights on product performance, adoption gaps, and user pain points.

Cross-Functional Communication

  • Coordinate across Product, Engineering, QA, UX, Client Services, Operations, Compliance, and other stakeholder groups.
  • Communicate product updates, known issues, release timelines, and training needs clearly to internal teams.
  • Help ensure feedback is gathered before and after delivery, and that product decisions are grounded in user needs, business impact, and operational realities.

What You Have:

  • 2–4+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Operations, Business Analysis, or Workflow Automation roles.
  • Strong ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery plans.
  • Comfort working with engineering, QA, UX, and business stakeholders in an agile environment.
  • Strong communication skills, verbal & written, including product documentation, release notes, training material, and stakeholder updates.
  • Analytical mindset with experience using product metrics, dashboards, user feedback, and operational data to guide product decisions.
  • Familiarity with AI products, LLM-powered workflows, recommendation systems, human-in-the-loop design, or automation products is strongly preferred.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary, bonus and benefits
  • Excellent medical coverage through BUPA
  • Excellent professional development opportunities
  • Supportive culture that celebrates and rewards success
  • Monthly Happy Hour, Social Events, Summer Fridays
  • Year-round company sponsored sports and team building events
  • Informal work environment
  • Employee Assistance Programs
  • Volunteer days

About Guidepoint: 

Guidepoint powers end-to-end research workflows for the world’s best research teams.

Backed by a global network of more than 2 million experts and over 1,600 employees, Guidepoint delivers real-time access to expertise, primary research, and actionable knowledge that help organizations make informed decisions. Through consultations, surveys, events, proprietary content, and AI-enabled tools, we support every stage of the decision-making process—from developing hypotheses and gathering insights to validating assumptions and building conviction for critical decisions.

At Guidepoint, our success relies on the diversity of our employees, experts, and clients, which enables us to foster meaningful connections and a broad range of perspectives. We are committed to creating an inclusive and welcoming environment where individuals of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences can contribute and succeed.

AI-gestützt entwickeln – und den Standard dafür setzen Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit Coding-Assistenten und Agenten, holst mehr aus ihnen heraus als Autocomplete und weißt genau, wo ihre Grenzen liegen. PostgreSQL), Datenmodellierung und Performance-Optimierung Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen (z. B. AWS), Docker und dem Betrieb von SaaS-Anwendungen AI-gestütztes Entwickeln ist für dich Alltag: Du arbeitest routiniert mit Coding-Assistenten und -Agenten (z. B. description: About Allica Bank Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech. Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers. Department Description Security is a hands-on, delivery-focused team that helps Allica Bank move quickly while maintaining strong, proportionate, and effective security controls. The team combines day-to-day operational support with continuous improvement, automation, control assurance, and stakeholder partnership across the bank. We work closely with Technology, Engineering, Product and business teams to make security practical and effective, while ensuring our controls support the requirements of a regulated banking environment. Role Description The purpose of this role is to strengthen Allica Bank's identity and access controls by making access easier to request, safer to approve and simpler to evidence. The role will combine day-to-day IAM operations with engineering, automation, and continuous improvement to reduce manual effort and improve the security and governance of identity services. The role sits within Security and focuses on Identity and Access Management, primarily across Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Entra Identity Governance, Azure identity, access management and security controls, with support for Google Cloud Platform IAM governance, engineering and automation as that capability develops. The successful candidate will contribute to the day-to-day running of IAM services, including access requests, joiner/mover/leaver activity, access reviews, privileged access, RBAC, application SSO, and application onboarding. Alongside BAU responsibilities, they will identify and deliver improvements to processes, controls, and automation. This is not a purely operational IAM role. The successful candidate will be expected to run IAM services, engineer improvements, automate repeatable work, strengthen controls and help mature identity services across the bank. Experience using automation and AI tools to improve processes, reduce manual effort and strengthen security controls is desirable. Success in this role will be measured through the quality and timeliness of IAM operations, stronger identity governance and evidence, improved automation, and reduced manual effort. Principal Accountabilities Operate and maintain IAM services, including user lifecycle management, access requests, provisioning, deprovisioning and access changes across Microsoft Entra ID and integrated applications. Manage identity governance and access controls, including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), least-privilege access, Conditional Access and Privileged Identity Management (PIM). Manage access reviews and certifications, including reviewer engagement, evidence collection, exception handling, remediation tracking and reporting. Onboard and integrate applications into the IAM/IGA platform, including SSO, SAML/OIDC, SCIM provisioning and secure authentication using Microsoft Entra ID. Support application and vendor onboarding from an IAM perspective, assessing authentication, provisioning, privileged access, logging, ownership and access review requirements. Maintain effective IAM controls and audit evidence, supporting internal and external audits and regulatory requirements. Identify and deliver improvements through automation, improved workflows, better request processes, clearer ownership and enhanced reporting, reducing manual effort and improving control effectiveness. Support identity-related issues and investigations, working with application owners, Technology, Security and other stakeholders to resolve access issues and manage associated risks. Maintain IAM documentation and operational standards, including process guides, access models, onboarding standards, control evidence, and runbooks. Support wider identity and cloud access services where needed, including Azure identity, access management and security controls, credential lifecycle management, and Google Cloud IAM governance, engineering and automation. Provide clear reporting to Security leadership, highlighting IAM risks, control status, work in progress, blockers, and remediation actions. Support related control and regulatory activities, including Risk Smart Indicators and Data Subject Access Requests, where IAM input or evidence is needed. Personal Attributes & Experience Experience in Identity and Access Management, Security Operations, Cloud Security or technical operations, ideally within a regulated or control-focused environment. Good hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID and Azure identity, access management and security controls, including users, groups, Enterprise Applications, SSO, Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management and access management controls. Understanding of IAM principles and controls, including least privilege, RBAC, privileged access, joiner/mover/leaver processes and segregation of duties. Experience supporting access reviews, remediation, audit evidence and operational controls, with strong attention to detail and follow-through. Comfortably balancing BAU operational work with hands-on engineering, including improving processes, writing or adapting scripts, documenting workflows and automating repeatable tasks. Able to work effectively with application owners, Technology, Security, suppliers and non-technical stakeholders to translate access requirements into practical and secure controls. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate access issues, identify root causes, and recommend practical improvements. Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain identity risks, controls and needed actions in plain English. Strong ownership and accountability, particularly where access approvals, evidence, remediation and control outcomes are involved. Understands the importance of effective, auditable controls in an FCA/PRA-regulated environment. Able to consider the end-user experience when designing and improving access processes, balancing security, usability, and operational efficiency. Microsoft identity and governance: Microsoft Entra Identity Governance, Conditional Access, PIM, access reviews and Enterprise Applications Automation and scripting: Microsoft Graph, PowerShell, Logic Apps, Azure Functions or similar automation tooling Azure identity, access management and security controls Application integration: SAML, SCIM, OAuth, OpenID Connect, SSO onboarding and secure provisioning patterns Google Cloud Platform IAM governance, access models, engineering standards and automation 1Password or similar credential management platforms Cloud audit logging and identity monitoring Service desk and IT workflow platforms The successful candidate does not need experience across every technology listed. Curiosity, the ability to learn quickly, and a strong understanding of IAM principles are more important than knowledge of a specific product. Working at Allica Bank At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers. Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind: Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities Options for flexible working Regular social activities Pension contributions Discretionary bonus scheme Private health cover Life assurance Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave Don’t tick every box? Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you! Flexible working We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate. Diversity We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like. description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

 

What does a Senior Account Manager - [ 4Month - FTC ] do at WPP Production? 

As part of the Client Services Department, you play a central role in the business and are pivotal to the smooth running of your account. You will be required to have a thorough understanding of all areas of the business and be responsible for managing projects from brief to final delivery on time and budget. You will be client focused and require good communication, organisation and time management skills to manage both your clients and internal departments, while always focusing on quality, process and profitability. 

 

What does a Senior Account Manager  [ 4Month - FTC ] do at WPP Production, on the TJX account? 

You will be working within the client’s Activation Account team, implanted onsite working on behalf of the client. You will attend TJX office in Watford two/three times a week and occasionally work from the WPP Production office in London. You will deliver projects, working with TJX’s onsite in-house creative team. You will be responsible for managing projects from briefing to final delivery, ensuring that TJX stakeholders, clients and agencies, adhere to set timings to ensure a timely delivery of all projects. You will be working on a range of Digital Media projects, such as Web, Email and Paid Media 

 

Client management responsibilities:  

  • Immerse yourself in the client’s brand and offering 
  • Prepare client proposals 
  • Present and deliver creative work appropriately – take ownership of your work and ensure best in class delivery of work to a high standard 
  • Provide weekly status reports, accompanied by a meeting or call as per client needs 
  • Provide agendas and detailed contact reports following all client meetings 
  • Set and manage client expectations deliverables and timeframes 
  • Escalate all serious client issues to your line manager immediately and recommend solutions wherever possible 
  • Identify areas for improvement of existing workflow and processes which could benefit WPP Production and/or the client 
  • Build strong day to day relationships with all clients and agency stakeholders – communication is key 
  • Identify training requirements and opportunities for clients to ensure their adherence to processes and improve workflow 

 

Project Management responsibilities:  

  • Co-ordinate between all relevant parties, this might be internally within the client TJX, internally within WPP Production or with other agencies and 3rdparty partners of TJX.  
  • Consistently deliver against all contractual obligations include SLAs and KPIs 
  • Manage client projects from brief to delivery ensuring final materials are on time and of the highest quality 
  • Follow agreed workflows and utilise relevant project management tools that the client uses – Workfront and Trello. 
  • Ensure clear division of responsibility for appropriate files at each stage of the project 
  • Where project managers/producers are involved, take responsibility for ongoing communication, tracking 
  • project progress and status vs. schedules, timings, delays etc. 
  • Manage, monitor and update all timelines and set realistic expectations with stakeholders 
  • Monitor internal workflows, identify areas for improvement and make recommendations 
  • Ensure Schedules, technical specs and copy dates are obtained and correct, report any delays to AD and/or TJX BAM 
  • Check all materials (PDFs, emails etc.) and ensure quality control procedures have been followed before sending to clients 
  • Keep AD and/or TJX BAM updated on status of projects 
  • Collate any information needed for input to client reports and presentations 
  • Help organise, attend (if required) and minute meetings 
  • Manage your workload effectively and highlight to your line manager if support is required to ensure successful 
  • completion of a project 
  • Manage other team members and become a mentor 
  • Provide administrative support team as required 

 

Reporting lines and key stakeholders 

This role reports to the Account Director, but you will have a dotted reporting line into a client lead (Brand Activation Manager. 

You will work closely with Creative, Digital and Production teams. 

 

Requirements 

  • Strong time management and prioritisation skills within a fast-paced environment 
  • Great attention to detail  
  • Can do attitude and an ability to work under pressure 
  • Strong interpersonal and proactive communication skills 
  • Fluent oral and written English, other languages desirable 
  • Highly organised, detail oriented and client focused 
  • Team Player 
  • Quick learner when it comes to different softwares 
  • Strong IT literacy, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint/Key 
  • Strong numeracy skills 
  • Basic understanding of Digital Media such as Web, Email and Paid Media is desirable 
  • Experience in managing and servicing multi market accounts in the retail space 
  • Experience working in Creative, Branding, Social, Digital or Print production 
  • Experience with creative adaptation briefs 

 

 

Why work here: 
At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact 
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Data
We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role We're looking for a Senior Accountant / Financial Reporting specialist to join our Finance Team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help strengthen core accounting execution, audit management, and monthly consolidated results analysis while being part of a high-growth environment as we scale our financial infrastructure. If you're excited about leveraging AI and automation to redefine modern accounting with a strong focus on IFRS excellence and financial rigor, then this is the opportunity for you! Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You’ll report to our Accounting Associate Director and work closely with teams across the Finance organisation. You will be part of a team dedicated to technical rigor and operational efficiency, partnering with cross-functional departments to elevate our accounting processes to the next level. What you’ll be doing As a Senior Accountant, you will: Prepare and post journal entries, perform balance sheet reconciliations, and drive high standards for period close improving quality and speed. Own the preparation of audit schedules, coordinate responses to requests, and drive the closure of audit questions to ensure a predictable, well-documented process. Deep dive into monthly results, flagging risks, unusual transactions, and key movements while providing decision-ready insights for finance leadership. Identify accounting risks, implement practical mitigations, and strengthen internal controls to ensure our processes are scalable and accurate. Actively leverage AI tools to improve efficiency and consistency, identifying opportunities to standardise and simplify recurring accounting work. What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: 6+ years of experience with a strong ability to apply IFRS in real-world scenarios. Comfort working with consolidated results, analysing variances, and exercising complex accounting estimates and judgments. Proven experience managing audits end-to-end or acting as the primary finance contact for external auditors. A track record (or clear potential) of using AI and automation to improve accounting outcomes and efficiency. The ability to operate effectively in a fast-changing environment with an "ownership mindset" and excellent judgment. Strong ability to translate complex accounting issues into scalable process improvements and clear insights for stakeholders. Why is this role a good fit for you This role is a good fit for you if: You want genuine agency at group level rather than executing instructions handed down by a central team You'd rather design a process than inherit one, and you want to see your own work implemented You like variety. This is a different topic most days, not a fixed monthly cycle This role is not a good fit for you if: You want a settled, mature environment where the process is set and the day looks the same. That's the clearest reason this role doesn't work out for people You need stable priorities. It's volatile here. Several topics run at once, progress depends on other people, and priorities can change overnight You want to stay inside accounting. A large part of the job is working with teams outside Finance and with external advisors in each country How you’ll develop in this role In your first 6 - 12 months at Pleo, you’ll: Lead the Audit Readiness initiative to drive impact in our year-end execution and documentation standards. Collaborate with the Finance team to embed AI-forward ways of working, automating manual workflows to increase team capacity. Grow your skills in process improvements and financial analysis, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale across our legal entity markets. We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger leadership projects, mastering the intersection of AI and Finance, or deepening your expertise in complex consolidated reporting. The location This role is hybrid (on average, 3 days a week in the office) and can be located in either our Lisbon or Madrid office. Show me the benefits! 💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!) 🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office 🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis 🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays 🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options 🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice ❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far 👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work The interview process We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows: Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background. Hiring manager interview: A conversation with our Accounting Associate Director covering your technical accounting and IFRS experience. Team panel and Pleo challenge: You'll meet the hiring manager, his manager and a peer from the team. The challenge is presented live in the session, so there's nothing to prepare or send in advance. We're looking at how you handle complexity, new areas and stakeholders. Final interview: A closing conversation, used where it's helpful for both sides. Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success! Last time we hired this role, we received a lot of applications but can only interview a finite number of people. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include: CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background! Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process. Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc. About your application English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us. A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails. Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us. Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you. Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here. Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role. Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: Build the Software Foundation for Next-Generation Mobility At Apex.AI, we develop safety-certified software for mobility systems and intelligent machines. Our products power applications in automotive, trucking, robotics, aerospace, agriculture, and industrial automation. We are looking for a Senior Applications Engineer who combines strong C++ engineering skills with a passion for solving complex customer challenges. In this role, you will work directly with global customers and internal product teams to design, build, deploy, and support advanced software solutions based on Apex.OS. You will help customers bring real-world systems to production while contributing improvements and features back into our core platform. This is a highly technical, hands-on role ideal for someone who enjoys deep systems engineering, customer collaboration, and writing production-quality C++ software. If you thrive in fast-moving environments, enjoy solving difficult distributed and embedded systems problems, and want to help shape the future of software-defined mobility, we’d love to talk with you. This role is located in our Munich office. Authorization to work in the Germany is required. What You’ll Do Roll out Apex.AI software to customers and provide technical support solutions using Apex.AI products Collaborate closely with customers to understand technical requirements and deliver high-quality implementations Deploy, integrate, and support Apex.AI software in customer environments Troubleshoot complex software, networking, middleware, and embedded systems issues Partner with internal engineering teams to improve product capabilities, usability, and performance Contribute features, fixes, and enhancements directly to Apex.OS Deliver technical presentations, workshops, and customer training sessions Help accelerate customer adoption and success across automotive and intelligent machine platforms What You Bring Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related technical field 5+ years of professional software development experience in modern C++ Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across complex software systems Experience developing software for embedded or distributed systems Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to work directly with customers and cross-functional teams Experience using modern development workflows and tools such as Git, GitLab, CI/CD pipelines, and issue tracking systems Self-driven and comfortable operating independently in dynamic technical environments Nice To Have Experience in automotive, robotics, aerospace, industrial automation, or other safety-critical domains Familiarity with operating systems, networking, and communication protocols (UDP, multicast, TCP/IP, DDS, ROS/ROS 2) Understanding of real-time systems and automotive software architectures such as AUTOSAR Experience in technical consulting, field engineering, developer support, or professional services Customer enablement or technical training experience Familiarity with build systems such as Bazel or CMake Experience working with Linux-based development environments Apex.AI is an international software company specializing in the development of safety-certified, developer-friendly, and scalable software for mobility systems, aiming to accelerate the transition to software-defined vehicles and mobility. Founded in 2017 by Jan Becker and Dejan Pangercic, the company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with additional offices in Munich, Stuttgart, Gothenburg, Tokyo, and Pangyo. To date, Apex.AI has raised over $75 million USD from world-class venture, financial and strategic investors including AGCO, Airbus Ventures, Canaan, Continental AG, Daimler Truck, HELLA Ventures, Jaguar Land Rover’s InMotion Ventures, LG Electronics, Lightspeed, Orillion, Toyota Ventures, Volvo Group Venture Capital and ZF. The company’s flagship product, Apex.OS, consists of two core components: Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida. Apex.Grace is an application runtime framework in the form of a software development kit (SDK). It provides a robust framework for developing real-time, reliable, and safe applications. Core APIs are based on ROS 2 APIs with numerous extensions enabling real-time execution, reliable performance, deployment into large fleets, system state management, safety, security, and much more. It is safety-certified to ISO 26262 ASIL D. Apex.Ida is a communication middleware delivering optimal high-performance data transport across use cases. These use cases range from fully autonomous vehicles with dozens of high-resolution cameras to small signals with ultra-high frequencies in safety-critical domains. Its core is based on a shared memory data transport with connectors into DDS, SOME/IP, MQTT, CAN, and many more protocols, all abstracted into a single application-facing API. Additionally, Apex.AI offers: Apex.Alan provides customers with a highly optimized and efficient software integration, development environment, build, test, and delivery process. Apex.OS for V&V enables record and playback of very large and diverse data streams, both time- and data-deterministically, which is crucial for replay, analysis, and performance evaluation of complex autonomous systems. Apex.AI’s software solutions are utilized across a diverse range of industries, including automotive, agriculture, medical, and defense sectors. The products enable developers to efficiently create and deploy safe, reliable, and high-performance applications, thereby accelerating the adoption of software-defined mobility systems. Through its innovative software solutions and strategic partnerships, Apex.AI is at the forefront of transforming the mobility industry, facilitating the development of next-generation vehicles and systems. Come help design and deliver cloud native solutions that power SharkNinja's connected device ecosystem. You'll build scalable backend services, IoT connectivity platforms, and APIs that enable seamless experiences between devices and mobile applications, working on the cloud infrastructure supporting SharkNinja's growing portfolio of connected products.

What You'll Do

Development and engineering

  • Design and develop scalable cloud services and APIs that power SharkNinja's connected device ecosystem.
  • Build IoT connectivity platforms using AWS IoT Core that enable reliable device to cloud communication for millions of connected products.
  • Collaborate with mobile, embedded, and hardware teams to deliver end to end connected product experiences.
  • Work with product management to define and refine product requirements.
  • Implement distributed systems using Lambda, Docker, Fargate, and AWS services that integrate cloud infrastructure with mobile apps and connected devices.
  • Write, execute, and automate tests to ensure reliability, performance, and consumer ready quality at scale.
  • Monitor, debug, and optimize cloud infrastructure performance using CloudWatch for consumer scale deployment across diverse device ecosystems.
  • Work closely with cross functional development teams spanning the entire software stack from embedded to mobile.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices.

Technical collaboration

  • Collaborate with senior technical leaders on cloud and IoT architecture decisions.
  • Partner with QA, mobile, and firmware engineers to ensure seamless integration across the stack.
  • Contribute to technical discussions and help refine engineering standards and patterns.
  • Mentor junior and mid level engineers through code reviews and pair programming.
  • Share knowledge and best practices with the broader engineering team.

What You'll Bring

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in software engineering with a focus on cloud native development.
  • Strong proficiency with TypeScript, Golang, and/or Python.
  • Solid experience with AWS services including Lambda, IoT Core, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, and SNS/SQS.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code tools, AWS CDK preferred.
  • Understanding of full stack system architecture and cloud to mobile integration patterns.
  • Experience working with cross functional development teams.
  • Knowledge of IoT protocols and device connectivity, including MQTT, HTTP/REST, and WebSockets.
  • Strong problem solving skills and the ability to debug complex distributed systems.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills.
  • A passion for creating consumer friendly, connected product experiences.
  • Curiosity, adaptability, and a drive to be part of an A Player engineering team.

Preferred:

  • Experience with AWS IoT Core, Kinesis data streaming, message queues (SNS/SQS), serverless architectures, and containerization (Docker).
  • Prior work with connected devices, IoT ecosystems, or large scale device management platforms.
  • Knowledge of BLE (Bluetooth Low Energy) and WiFi connectivity protocols.
  • Experience with TypeScript, Python, Rust, Go, C/C++, or other systems programming languages.
  • Comfort with AI assisted development workflows and modern developer tooling.
  • Experience with AWS Bedrock, AI powered development tools, or prompt engineering for software development tasks.
  • Background in robotics, consumer electronics, or smart home products.
  • Contributions to open source projects.
  • Experience mentoring other engineers.

Technical skills, required: TypeScript, Python, and Go; AWS services including Lambda, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, and SNS/SQS; infrastructure as code via AWS CDK; IoT protocols including MQTT, HTTP/REST, and WebSockets; Docker for containerization; Git for version control; and AWS CodePipeline or similar for CI/CD.

Technical skills, nice to have: Rust and C/C++; AWS services including Kinesis, Step Functions, API Gateway, S3, and Athena; BLE and WiFi connectivity; distributed tracing alongside CloudWatch; and AI tools such as AWS Bedrock, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot.
